name: Medicines
duplicates: The old Figma (健康与治疗) has no medicine list: a drug name is typed on each treatment. Before this feature, Record treatment's medicine picker (health-record.medicine-picker) held a placeholder catalogue and a Brand field with sample brands.

entryPoints.label: Record treatment for several pigs, Medicine field
A vaccination task on a pig, Vaccine field

addsTo.what: A Medicines row (the farm's medicine list: its brands, and rename and delete what the farm added)

The Medicine field of Record treatment and Record vaccination opens this picker; Method and unit are pre-filled from the medicine's last use; Brand is an optional row from the farm's brands for that medicine

flow: type a name with no match
tap a medicine the farm added

screens.name: Choose a medicine: recent, then categories
screens.zh: 选择药品：最近使用与分类

notes.purpose: Pick what was given, over the real Record treatment page: search, the farm's recent medicines, then the categories.

elements.name: Recently used
elements.shows: Up to three medicines the farm picked last, under the group label Recently used; no second line

states.when: The farm has recorded a treatment
Nothing recorded yet, or none fits the task
states.shows: The block is absent; the categories lose their label (medicines.picker-first)

elements.logic: Distinct, newest first, any worker, filtered to the task (a vaccination shows vaccines only). A deleted medicine leaves it.

elements.name: Category rows
elements.shows: The fixed category list, the same on every farm; no second line
elements.rule: A tap opens the category as a level; the footer Back comes back here, the ✕ closes the picker.

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet. Its default withdrawals are sample values, to be verified against the official withdrawal periods (China: MOA Announcement No. 278 and its updates) before release.
Brands, recent picks and remembered methods are sample farm data.

screens.name: Choose a medicine: no recent picks

notes.purpose: The picker on a farm that has recorded no treatment yet: search, then the categories with no group label.
issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

notes.purpose: One list of the category's medicines; a tap picks one and closes.

elements.name: Medicine row
elements.shows: The medicine's name, no second line

states.shows: Its name in the worker's language

elements.name: Search
elements.rule: Searches every category from here; while it has text the head names the root (Medicines). The footer Back goes up to Medicines.

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

notes.purpose: Results from every category, each with its category as the second line.

elements.name: Result row
elements.shows: Medicine, with its category as meta
elements.logic: Search mixes categories, so the category is what tells two results apart. Matches the English and Chinese names and common other names (PRRS: blue ear; PCV2: circovirus). In a vaccination only vaccines are searched, and the meta is dropped (one category).

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

notes.purpose: The same picker filtered to Vaccines, named by disease: recent vaccines, then every vaccine.

elements.name: Vaccine list
elements.shows: One category left, so its diseases are listed at once under the label All vaccines, which differs from the title (no one-row category level)
elements.logic: Recents and search are filtered to Vaccines; adding files the new vaccine under Vaccines.

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

notes.purpose: Nothing matches: one card, Add “Cefquinome”, and nothing else.
Name (pre-filled from the search) and Category; the category is set already when the search was typed inside one.

elements.name: Add
elements.rule: Waits until Name and Category are set; a tap while waiting marks them Required. Adding puts the medicine into the farm's list for everyone at once and picks it: the drawer closes on the form.

notes.purpose: The seven categories; one tap sets it and goes back up to Add a medicine.
The farm's medicine list by category. Reached from Home → Toolbox → Medicines (not built on Home yet).
issues: The Toolbox row on Home is not built (addsTo, added: false).

notes.purpose: A category's medicines, the starting list and the farm's own, one row each.
issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

screens.name: A medicine's sheet (starting list): default withdrawal, brands

notes.purpose: An edit form: the name is the title and read-only, the withdrawal period (days) is the one editable field, prefilled from the starting list, then the brands the farm has used. No Delete. Footer Back + Save (waits until something changes).

elements.name: Default withdrawal
elements.logic: Used on a treatment when no brand is chosen, or the chosen brand has none (the usual case). Save changes it for everyone from the next treatment; records already saved keep their copy.

elements.name: Brands
elements.shows: Each brand, one row, no second line (a strength that matters is in the brand's name)

issues: The default withdrawals in the starting list are sample values, to be verified against the official withdrawal periods (China: MOA Announcement No. 278 and its updates) before release; not authoritative.

screens.name: A medicine the farm added: name, default withdrawal, brands, Delete

notes.purpose: An edit form: Name and Default withdrawal editable, then its brands, then Delete medicine (a navigate Row in its own card, opening a confirm level). Footer Back + Save.
issues: Who may rename and delete is a permissions rule to confirm (the prototype lets anyone).

screens.name: A brand's sheet: name, withdrawal override, Delete

notes.purpose: An edit form: Name and Withdrawal period (days) as fields, then Delete brand (a navigate Row in its own card, opening a confirm level). Footer Back + Save.

elements.name: Withdrawal
elements.shows: 2, with "Uses Amoxicillin's 14 days when empty" under it
elements.logic: The medicine's default is the usual case; a brand overrides it only when its label differs. Empty means the default applies.

elements.name: Name
elements.logic: There is no strength field: when strength matters it is part of the name, so a brand sold in two strengths is two entries (Amoxinsol 15%, Amoxinsol 50%).

issues: Brands and their withdrawals are sample farm data.

notes.purpose: Delete brand's confirm level: what happens to past records, then Delete in red.

elements.name: Delete
elements.rule: Takes the brand off the Brand list and this page; past records keep its name. The same level deletes a farm-added medicine (Delete medicine).
